data.name: Kashafiyah
data.gender_notes: Kashafiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘kashafa’ which means 'to unveil' or 'to reveal'. In Islamic context, Kashafiyah refers to the one who unveils or reveals the truth, or the one who is granted divine guidance. It is also the name of a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for her wisdom and knowledge. The name Kashafiyah carries the meaning “Unveiling, Disclosure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kashafiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody unveiling, disclosure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Kashafiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unveiling, Disclosure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kashafiyah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

It is a name that reminds us of the importance of education and the pursuit of truth, which is a fundamental aspect of Islamic culture.

The name is also reminiscent of the statement of Allah (swt) from the Quran: "And Allah is the One Who knows best about that which is in the belly and even that which lies hidden within the earth. Kashafiyah is a reminder that with divine guidance, all truths can be revealed and unveiled in one's life.
